{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-hi-x","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"c91abf188772e6c33a780e9b9369c5ecde63678da33c2f1c3f173454c407392c","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-hi-class-3:lineage:55","source_registry_sha256":"1323c0f691f132d6e9e9a263c68306b972b82c8bbaa5a48a33a79177660764be","source_liveness_sha256":"27cf6d56fae2d5323c61bcbb69f0d992aeceb71a7dae4302b1f14baa17651cb0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Backing, Entering Traffic, Roundabouts, Lanes, Speed, Turns, Passing, Stopping and Brakes","heading":"C2 — KG hints for Backing, Entering Traffic, Roundabouts, Lanes, Speed, Turns, Passing, Stopping and Brakes","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — KG hints for Backing, Entering Traffic, Roundabouts, Lanes, Speed, Turns, Passing, Stopping and Brakes

FACT_ID: sec13-R01 | anchor: A05
When a conflict appears mid-pass you brake and fall back, while speeding up to finish the pass is the move the manual forbids [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint passing; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec13-F30 and sec13-F29.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec13-R02 | anchor: A04
The two-second count sets the minimum following interval, while the rear-tires view sets the minimum stopping gap in traffic [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint spacing; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec13-F19 and sec13-F40.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec13-R03 | anchor: A02
In a roundabout you look left and yield to circulating traffic, while to leave it you signal with the right turn signal [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint roundabouts; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec13-F09 and sec13-F08.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec13-R04 | anchor: A03
Changing lanes requires yielding to the vehicles already in the other lane, while changing lanes at or through an intersection or crosswalk is never allowed at all [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint lane-changes; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec13-F15 and sec13-F12.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec13-R05 | anchor: A02
With two lanes in open traffic the right lane is the travel lane and the left is for passing, while with three or more lanes the center lanes are the travel lanes and the outer lanes serve entering and leaving traffic [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint lane-choice; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec13-F10 and sec13-F11.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec13-R06 | anchor: A05
A vehicle turning left may be passed carefully on the right, while passing on the shoulder is prohibited in that same situation [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint passing; prereq_hint sec13-R01; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec13-F28 and sec13-F31.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec13-R07 | anchor: A07
In an emergency without antilock brakes you pump the brakes and steer clear, while jamming the brakes slides the wheels and removes steering control [A07].
Why it matters: group_hint braking; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec13-F37 and sec13-F36.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec13-R08 | anchor: A04
While waiting to turn left on green you keep the wheels straight and creep into the intersection, while a right turn on red always begins with a complete stop [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint turns; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec13-F25 and sec13-F26.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec13-R09 | anchor: A01
Leaving a driveway requires a stop before the sidewalk, while backing out of a parking space places the chief collision responsibility on the driver leaving the space [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint entering-traffic; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec13-F06 and sec13-F04.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec13-R10 | anchor: A02
Leaving a parallel space is a forward move into the nearest lane, while leaving a diagonal space means backing into the lane, which is slower and more dangerous [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint entering-traffic; prereq_hint sec13-R09; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec13-F07 and sec13-F03.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec13-R11 | anchor: A07
Downshifting before a steep grade lets the engine hold speed, while prolonged braking on the grade overheats the brakes and weakens them [A07].
Why it matters: group_hint braking; prereq_hint sec13-R07; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec13-F43 and sec13-F41.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec13-R12 | anchor: A01
A child under nine may not be left alone in a vehicle for five minutes or more, while children playing behind parked cars are the reason for extra caution when backing in residential areas [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint children; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec13-F01 and sec13-F05.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec13-R13 | anchor: A06
A driver who has just parked should be assumed about to open the door, while a parked car showing lamps, exhaust vapor or turning wheels should be assumed about to pull out [A06].
Why it matters: group_hint parked-cars; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec13-F32 and sec13-F33.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0069]
